name: React
summary: Official documentation for React: tutorials, guides to hooks, state and effects, and a full API reference.
description: react.dev is the official home of React, the library for web and native user interfaces. Learn React walks through component-based UI step by step — quick start, a tic-tac-toe tutorial, describing the UI, adding interactivity, managing state, escape hatches — and the API Reference documents hooks, React DOM APIs, Server Components, the React Compiler, the ESLint plugin and the Rules of React. Pages also exist as plain .md files and an llms.txt index lists them for AI agents.
